notes.title: Ver1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the HEAVEN SEEKER development team.
Today, we released Ver1.0.2.
Please see below for the details of the fixes and adjustments.

<Fixes>
・Fixed issues where some achievements could not be obtained:
　- "Unlock All Skills": If the conditions are already met, the achievement will be unlocked upon entering the entrance.
　- "Retain Coins": The achievement will be unlocked by meeting the specified conditions.

・Fixed the following issues with the Grimoire "Thunder":
　- The default trajectory of Thunder was not normal.
　- It was always treated as the minimum value regardless of the accuracy status.
　- When the side book "Burst Bullet" is applied, a shadow of Thunder may occur.

・Fixed the following issues with the side book "Chain Spell":
　- If already hopped with the effect of the side book "Hopper Spell" before chaining, it could not hop again after chaining.

・Fixed the issue where the effect of the artifact "Dodge Manual III" was not working correctly.

・Fixed the following issues with the artifacts "Golden Magic Clock" and "Silver Magic Clock":
　- Not registered in the encyclopedia even when obtained.
　- Disappearing from the inventory when moving areas after acquisition.

・Fixed the issue where the number of bombs obtained by artifact effects exceeded the limit:
　- The maximum number is now 10, just like normal bomb acquisition, and will not exceed this limit.

・Fixed the issue where the beam shot by enemies had a larger hitbox than it appeared.
・Fixed the issue where combos did not increase when defeating the enemy "Devil in the box".
・Fixed the issue where rewards could appear during the defeat sequence of the boss in Area 4.

・Fixed the following UI issues:
　- Able to enter the dungeon while displaying the difficulty UI by interacting again during the dungeon entry sequence.
　- Tooltips in the inventory (item information) could go off-screen.
　- "Mana Consumption Correction" displayed twice in the Grimoire calibration effects section when a side book is applied.
　- Dice possession display misaligns when obtaining dice continuously in a short period.

・Fixed the issue where setting "Slow + Shot" in key configuration made the operation non-functional.
・Fixed the issue where Japanese appeared in the English version during the judgment room.

<Adjustments>
・Adjusted to reduce the occurrence of forced termination.
・Relaxed the activation conditions for dodging, making inputs easier to accept.

・Adjusted some game balance:
　- Mana consumption correction status has been adjusted.

・Adjusted the text of some side books.

notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello. This is the HEAVEN SEEKER development team.
Thank you for reporting the bugs.
We have released an update that includes the following fixes and adjustments.

＜Fixes＞
・Fixed an issue where certain achievements could not be obtained correctly.
　-Some achievements requiring no bombs or no damage under specific conditions could not be obtained.
　-Achievements requiring the acquisition of all items and other elements could not be unlocked properly.
　※For achievements requiring the acquisition of all items, if you have already met the conditions, the check for obtaining them will be executed at the following times:
　　When you start an exploration / When you acquire any item in the dungeon.
・Corrected the behavior of the Grimoire "Thunder."
　-The re-shooting position of shots due to the effect of the side book "Chain Spell" was incorrect.
・Fixed an issue where the Grimoire calibration effect of the side book "Spell Lightening" was not displayed correctly.
・Fixed the following issues related to the delay field generated by some enemies:
　-The effect moved along with the enemy's movement, causing a discrepancy with the actual effective range.
・Corrected an issue where images of some side books in the compendium were reversed.
・Fixed the following issues in Sky Castle History:
　-When displaying result details, "High Score" and "New Record" appeared regardless of the actual record.
　-The sorting results for ascending and descending order in "Recent Records" were reversed.
　-In the "Clear Time" category of the history, results that did not meet the conditions were displayed.
・Fixed the following issues in the options menu:
　-After setting the control method from presets, reopening the options menu reset it to default.
　-The "Reset to Default" function in the free key configuration settings did not work correctly.

＜Adjustments＞
・Adjusted the terrain of the entrance.
・Adjusted the terrain of some dungeons to address areas where attacks might not reach.
・Adjusted the default master volume to 50%.
・Made some adjustments to the display of credits and end rolls.

We are currently reviewing and addressing other reported issues.
Thank you for your continued support of HEAVEN SEEKER.

notes.title: Notice Regarding the Full Version
notes.notes:
We would like to introduce the controls for the full version and information on current issues.

<Notice>
This is a topic about the controls. It is intended for those who have played the Prologue version.
To make it easier and more enjoyable to play, we have changed the default controls. We have adjusted some key configurations for both keyboard & mouse and gamepad operations. We hope that even those who played the Prologue version will go through the tutorial.

Additionally, we have provided a feature to freely change key configurations, so please make use of it.

<Issues>
Next, we would like to inform you about known issues. We are working to fix the following bugs as soon as possible:
・In the boss battle of Area 4, if defeated at a specific timing, the attacks do not stop.
・In certain boss battles, rewards for no-damage victories are not granted.
・Some achievements that require no damage may not be obtained correctly.
・When setting controls using presets, reopening the control options screen resets them to default.
・The "Reset to Default" option does not function correctly in the free key configuration settings.
・The clear time order and recent record display in the Sky Castle History are not displayed correctly.

Thank you for your support of 'Heaven Seeker'.

Heaven Seeker Development Team

notes.title: HEAVEN SEEKER is released!
notes.notes:
Hello. I'm TwY, the producer of HEAVEN SEEKER.
Today, on June 21, 2024, at 6:00 PM (JST), we have released HEAVEN SEEKER: The Way to Save This Cruel World!

It's been 8 months since the release of the Prologue.
It felt long, yet it passed in the blink of an eye.

I want to thank everyone who supported us, everyone who attended our events, all the parties involved, and on behalf of the development team, I express my gratitude.

Even at this stage, we believe it is something fun, but we want to grow this child bigger, have many people play it, and hear them say it’s fun.

notes.title: Development Notes Vol.4
notes.notes:
Hello. I'm TwY, the producer of HEAVEN SEEKER.
We have now reached Vol.4 of our development notes.
This time, we will introduce features we forgot to mention last time, as well as new Grimoires and side books.

[u][b]■Bomb Evasion Function[/b][/u]
This new feature was actually included in the PV revealed at Tokyo Game Dungeon.
When you activate a bomb at the moment you take damage, it nullifies the hit.
Additionally, if you are hit when you have only 1 HP left, the screen will briefly slow down, different from the usual damage animation. Using a bomb during this slow-motion period will also nullify the hit.
However, be aware that if you use this feature repeatedly during the same exploration, the slow-motion period will gradually shorten, eventually returning to the normal reaction time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/fef0d3483697ecc112e4df472b44289bdc72e83b.gif[/img]

[u][b]■New Grimoires[/b][/u]
In the Prologue version, there were three types of Grimoires, but in the full version, many more Grimoires will be added.
Besides the two Grimoires for new characters that were previously introduced, there are also many Grimoires that can be unlocked by meeting certain conditions.
This time, we will introduce three of the Grimoires that can be unlocked by meeting these conditions.

【Sparkler】
This Grimoire rapidly fires low-power magic projectiles.
While its attack power is low, it has the fastest firing speed among all Grimoires.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/2b77f1a5984c9272e7cb41aa334213165d78868b.gif[/img]

【Kamaitachi】
This Grimoire launches wide-range slashing attacks.
The slashes gradually slow down and disappear when they come to a stop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/1ddeefba35f5c2f26d27c9e92b244d03a447ce80.gif[/img]

【FairyArrow】
This Grimoire fires magic arrows that fly straight without wavering.
Unlike the Spirit Arrow, this Grimoire stays in place while you hold down the shot button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/0bd1e8ccb676e96bcfb3d805e41e2f2f010a0fdf.gif[/img]

[u][b]■New Side Books[/b][/u]
In the full version, new side books that were not present in the Prologue version have been added.
Here, we will introduce a few of them.
Some side books are quite user-friendly, while others have unique quirks. Try out various combinations to find the best ones for you.

【RightBullet】
When you fire a shot, it also releases a projectile that flies to the right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/a471683fbe38959efb30224642d1b067933a1851.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/6371d557c674d6800cf6856f8edae8009e6418d1.png[/img]

【LastStruggleSpell】
When a projectile naturally disappears, it scatters additional projectiles from that point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/12b796a551129020b280c24b9626e972e5f8c6bb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/0fbf54e08dc4ca99743ab9753b5f58fab7753605.png[/img]

【PileSpell】
Projectiles increased by the side book's effect gather at a single point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/70a60031bad3be55c6ed97e4d6dfeeec51854007.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/2b329026a317c7abcdc3ca84fc16364cd7c30dd7.png[/img]

【BowlingSpell】
Increases power significantly but causes projectiles to fall into holes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/5d9cd020397b609716a59cf9fb581d14f559f3d6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/7a64a8bd265fffd9a84b457d6df7a20092af789a.png[/img]

That concludes Vol.4.
There are many more new Grimoires and new side books that we are eager to introduce, but revealing everything would take away from the fun of discovery during gameplay. So, we'll stop here for now.
Next time, we hope to make a major announcement!

notes.title: Development Notes Vol.3
notes.notes:
Hello. I'm TwY, the producer of HEAVEN SEEKER.
In Vol.3, we will introduce the new layers presented at the shooters fes, as well as the enemies briefly shown in the PV, and new features that were not introduced at the shooters fes.

[u][b]New Areas[/b][/u]
In the Prologue version, you could play the first half of the game, but in the full version, you will be able to explore the Sky castle until the end. We will introduce two new exploration areas: the "Prison Area" and the "Frozen Area."

[u][b]Prison Area[/b][/u]
In the fourth layer, enemies different from those in previous areas will appear. Completely new battles will unfold, not just extensions of what you've seen before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/cd6f1d65bf4436319050e3b621f0fbacf586cb2a.png[/img]

[u][b]Frozen Area[/b][/u]
The fifth layer is a suitable place for the final stage. There are also gimmicks associated with "ice," making it quite challenging.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/bddeb1f7a779ab887e46437231f4c63360210a8b.png[/img]
Please check the full version to see what kind of battles await you. We hope you look forward to it.

[u][b]New Enemies in Existing Layers[/b][/u]
New enemies have been placed in the layers you experienced in the Prologue version, so you should have a different gameplay experience. They are quite formidable opponents, so those who have honed their skills in the Prologue should definitely try and experience the differences.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/538df44239caff32514984b0e7434dcf3baad669.png[/img]

[u][b]Addition of Wave Count UI[/b][/u]
Although we could not introduce this in the shooters fes product version explanation, a new feature has been added to notify you of the number of waves. There has been talk of "wanting to be able to check the battle progress of the room" for some time, so we took the time to consider a clear and non-intrusive way to express this. We hope you like it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/b039b09dda4c53f4af3a2acb699a4cc1b209ed38.gif[/img]

[u][b]Suspend Feature[/b][/u]
A new suspend feature has also been added. You can now select "Suspend" at the portals that are the goal of each area. Selecting suspend allows you to save your exploration status and return to the title screen. This way, when you play next time, you can resume your exploration from the title menu's "CONTINUE" (exploration will resume from the next area). It’s a convenient feature when you want to take a break.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/0eb7a1080cde11ed0c0017cdd52d23da6aabaf42.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/6e854558d96d08386a4468a46b241877851fb2b4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/20101b0d2ff56ad438b6cceee9b777bad04eb914.png[/img]

That concludes Vol.3. Next time, we hope to introduce new Grimoires and side books, so please look forward to it!

notes.title: Development Notes Vol.2
notes.notes:
Hello. I am TwY, the producer of HEAVEN SEEKER.
Vol.2 will also be a review of the new features introduced at the shooters fes.

■ About Abysses (Pits)
One common issue raised in reviews and at events was the difficulty in seeing abysses (pits). To address this, a [!] will now appear when you approach an abyss. This indicator doesn't appear all the time, so you can still enjoy the dungeon atmosphere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/fb00687030d6364dd9a4fa3b0f4e809fa75f608b.gif[/img]

■ Skill Function
A skill function will be implemented to make conquering the sky castle easier. You can set skills without exceeding the skill capacity value. Skills such as auto-aim and HP boost are available to help you in your sky castle conquest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/6a405c8920fac7fc739f752c4613bb2b04cb9f1b.png[/img]

■ Difficulty Selection Added
In the Prologue, there was no difficulty selection, but in the full version, you can now set the difficulty level. This makes it easier for players who are not comfortable with omnidirectional shooting to enjoy the game. Additionally, increasing the difficulty level will apply a score multiplier, so for those seeking higher scores, we recommend playing on a higher difficulty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/505e0d938925009ae927edc16a3fee1cfcd6495a.png[/img]

Next time, we will introduce the new floors and enemies showcased at the shooters fes, as well as new features that have not yet been revealed. Please look forward to Vol.3!

notes.title: Development Notes Vol.1
notes.notes:
Hello. I am TwY, the producer of HEAVEN SEEKER. In the Prologue, we received numerous valuable comments from many customers. We have carefully examined these comments within our team and are utilizing them in the development of the full product. Starting with this note, I would like to share with you some of the additions to the full product version that were not in the Prologue version over several installments.
Essentially, this will be a reintroduction of the content I previously shared at the "shooters fes" where I had the opportunity to participate.

■ Additional Characters
In the Prologue, you could play with three characters, but in the full product version, additional playable characters have been added, bringing the total to five. Similar to the Prologue version, each explorer has a corresponding grimoire prepared, and their unique traits are expressed through their stats.

[u][b]PENTAS41[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/f37dea5e36f95600c4ee943c332b4fe00120f7b3.png[/img]
PENTAS41 is a character who uses a unique grimoire to conquer sky castles, featuring a beam that reaches its target instantly and hits continuously. This grimoire makes it easier to accumulate scores, and using it may facilitate the re-rolling of treasure chests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/5f00912a7049dbe5d025e2bfd783ac6e88489053.gif[/img]

[u][b]Merial[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/52381141e6813b3b3267c73f62a3dae7aef3f80c.png[/img]
Merial initial grimoire, Thunder, has a higher attack power per shot compared to the Spirit Arrow. However, its trajectory is whimsical like lightning, which may make it difficult to use in some situations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994491/4ae9b857630357f96243574a383576c46f24fe15.gif[/img]

Of course, the newly added grimoires can also be freely customized by combining them with sidebooks.

■ Tuning of Existing Explorers
In addition to implementing new characters, we are also adjusting characters that appeared in the Prologue. We are tuning each character to have their own strengths, while also ensuring they don't have overly significant disadvantages.

That was Development Notes Vol.1. Next time, we plan to introduce a new system. Look forward to the changes many have requested and the introduction of systems not present in the Prologue！
Please note that the information above is from the development phase, and the final implementation may differ.
